verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents registrable outbound webhooks. They are configured under Settings > Integrations and deliver HTTP POST notifications when an account changes, with SHA-256 HMAC signatures, exponential-backoff retries (up to 20 attempts), a request log, and an event.created event fired on new bookings. Missing for 10: explicit documented event types for reschedules and cancellations (only implied by 'listen for changes'), independent or hands-on corroboration.
